_comment: Wording that belongs to OrionLayer rather than to MOO2. The help TEXT itself comes from the game's own HELP.LBX and is written to help_<lang>.json by tools/help_extract.py; this file only holds the frame around it, so a translation replaces it without touching code (decision 15).
missing_body:
MOO2's help texts live in your own game installation, not in OrionLayer. Extract them once with:

python tools/help_extract.py

The tool reads HELP.LBX from the Master of Orion 2 folder and writes assets/shared/help/help_en.json. Nothing else changes.
stale_body:
The help file was written by an older version of the extractor and is missing layout information. Run it again:

python tools/help_extract.py
unknown_body: The help file loaded, but it has no entry {id}. That points at a different game version or a different language file, not at a missing extraction step.
